focus.name: embedded-word-pair
focus.purpose: Partition the compact 0x001B32C8 code-like block into its exact helper and adjacent four-byte value without assigning an unsupported PRNG or runtime role.

function.name: Utility_AdvanceEmbeddedWordPair
function.contract: Load two words from 0x001B32DE, add the second into the first, add the new first into the second with carry, store both words back, and return.

limitations: The whole-ROM export reports no direct static caller for the helper.
The destination lies in the ROM address range; whether this is intentionally unreachable code, a writable mapped mirror, or an artifact of a packed/data region is unresolved.
